[[Kriens]], [[Switzerland]] | capacity = 5,360 (540 seated) | season = [[2025–26 Promotion League|2025–26]] | league = [[Swiss Challenge League]] | position = 1st of 18 (Promoted) | website = https://sckriens.ch/ | pattern_la1 = | pattern_la2 = _white_stripes | pattern_b1 = | pattern_b2 = _whitestripes | pattern_ra1 = | pattern_ra2 = _white_stripes | leftarm1 = FFFFFF | leftarm2 = 04b404 | body1 = FFFFFF | body2 = 04b404 | rightarm1 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = 04b404 | shorts1 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = FFFFFF | socks1 = FFFFFF | socks2 = 04b404 }} '''SC Kriens''' is a Swiss [[association football|football]] club based in [[Kriens]], [[Canton of Lucerne|Lucerne]]. Founded in 1944, the club will compete in the [[Swiss Challenge League]], the second tier of Swiss football, for the [[2026–27 Swiss Challenge League|2026–27 season]] following promotion from the [[Promotion League]]. The team plays its home matches at [[Stadion Kleinfeld]] and maintains a local rivalry with [[FC Luzern]]. [[SC Kriens (women)|SC Kriens women's team]] has been participating in the [[Nationalliga A (women's football)|Nationalliga A]] since 2008."}}
